final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same evidence into a narrower position. That narrower position is analytically stronger than the original claim, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats on this record. The distinction is that a true caveat can qualify an otherwise satisfied compliance showing; here, disclosure or approved risk acceptance is itself an unresolved compliance predicate for a material weakness tied to a named contractual segment. Without evidence that the required disclosure has been made or that an approved exception exists, the record still does not support certification now. The Actor's concessions reinforce the initial concern rather than cure it.
remaining_concerns: No genuinely new admissible evidence was provided after the initial report; the Actor mainly narrowed and caveated the same record.
The policy text still makes the weakness material because it affects a named contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
The legal disclosure question remains open, which the policy text specifically treats as relevant rather than curative.
There is still no admissible evidence of an approved exception, waiver, or risk acceptance authorizing launch with this unresolved material limitation.
Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public guidance on monitoring/documentation remain secondary and do not satisfy the unresolved materiality and approval predicate.
